title: MOCK TEST
WASTED?
scenes.sub: Do this for 20 minutes after every mock
scenes.voice: You gave a mock, saw the score, and closed it? That mock is wasted. Do this for twenty minutes instead.

scenes.title: Minutes 1 to 5: Sort
scenes.voice: First five minutes. Mark every wrong question as one of three types. S for silly mistake. C for concept not known. T for time: you knew it, but ran out of time.

scenes.title: Minutes 5 to 15: Redo
lines: Redo only S and T questions
Do not look at the solution
scenes.voice: Next ten minutes. Redo only the S and T questions, without looking at the solution. These are marks you already own.

scenes.title: Minutes 15 to 20: Note
lines: One line for each C question
scenes.voice: Last five minutes. For each C question, write one line in your error notebook: the topic, and the one idea you were missing.

scenes.title: Next Mock Target
scenes.voice: In your next mock, the target is not a higher score. It is fewer silly mistakes. Do this after every test, and you stop losing marks you already know.
